description: ycardinale and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. BEMOnt is the released ontology at the core of the historical BEMServer platform. Its native software deposit identifies a versioned repository archive. The related OntoH2G publication describes a semantic model for buildings, equipment and occupants in this same project. These are retained as related ontology-family evidence, without asserting that the names represent byte-identical schemas. The resource supplies structured meaning for building-energy observations and equipment used by the management and modelling services. It is catalogued as an information/ontology resource, not as a simulator or a set of measured building values. Current compatibility with the later BEMServer refactor is not established. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label other-open. These terms describe the deposit; a paper licence does not establish a software licence. Coverage is limited to the stated sites, model settings and application examples. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected. Linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
